reason: I'd try a drop-in or two once it opens, and bring a couple moms from my group if it looks good. I wouldn't commit to a membership until I'd seen how it's run, because nothing here tells me how clean it is.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth, and a play space full of shared toys and other people's sick kids worries me. Nothing here says how toys get cleaned or what the sick-child rule is.
would_change_my_mind: A clear posted cleaning routine (toys sanitized between sessions, a sick-child policy) that I could see in person or read before paying.
